notes.title: June Update
notes.content:
June Update - Stability & Gameplay Enhancements

  [hr][/hr]

  🕹️ Controller & Input Improvements

  Enhanced Gamepad Support
  
  Gamepad controls added to pause menu
  Full controller support for save/load operations
  Improved Steam Input integration across all platforms
  

  [hr][/hr]

  🌳 New Gameplay Features

  Environmental System
  
  Interactive trees added to the world with RoundRects (R.I.P. Bill Atkinson)
  Environmental destruction mechanics
  Visual enhancements with new vegetation
  

  Expanded World
  
  Larger map areas to explore
  Improved map interface with better text readability
  New areas with unique content
  

  [hr][/hr]

  🤖 NPC & Dialog Improvements

  Enhanced NPC System
  
  Improved NPC behavior and pathfinding
  Better collision detection for NPCs
  New entity-based NPC system replacing tile-based NPCs
  

  Dialog Enhancements
  
  New fortune teller character with dynamically generated dialog
  Redesigned dialog UI with better visual presentation
  Enhanced interaction system for smoother conversations
  Improved memory management for dialog system
  

  [hr][/hr]

  🔧 Technical Improvements

  Build System Updates
  
  Switched to Clang compiler for better performance
  AddressSanitizer enabled for improved stability
  Cross-platform build fixes for Windows, Mac, and Linux
  

  Circuit System Fixes
  
  Fixed circuit text reset issues
  Improved memory handling in circuit puzzles
  Better performance for complex circuits
  

  [hr][/hr]

  🐛 Bug Fixes

  
  Fixed NPC spawning issues on certain maps
  Resolved out-of-bounds memory access bugs
  Fixed various casting issues for better stability
  Audio system improvements and fixes
  

  [hr][/hr]

  💡 What This Means for Players

  [expand type=details expanded=false]
  This update brings major platform expansion and gameplay improvements:

  
  Richer World - Interactive environments with trees and expanded exploration areas
  Smarter NPCs - More realistic behavior and better interactions
  Improved Stability - Technical improvements for smoother gameplay
  

  The new features enhance:
  
  Environmental interaction and player choice
  Dialog depth with new characters
  Overall game stability and performance
  
  [/expand]

notes.title: May Update
notes.content:
Major Update - Code Refactoring & Improvements

[hr][/hr]

🔧 Major Architecture Changes


Circuit System Fixes
Save System Fixes

[hr][/hr]

🔊 Audio System Enhancements

Audio System Overhaul

New audio functionality and features
Enhanced audio processing capabilities


Memory Leak Fixes

Fixed audio resource leaks
Improved memory management in audio system


[hr][/hr]

🐧 Platform & Build Improvements

Linux Compatibility Fixes 

Fixed game loading issues specific to Linux platform
Improved cross-platform compatibility
Refactored better platform support



[hr][/hr]

🐛 Bug Fixes

Achievement System 

Fixed excessive logging spam in achievement system
Improved performance by reducing unnecessary log output



💡 What This Means for Players

[expand type=details expanded=false]
This update represents a significant code refactoring effort focused on:


Better Performance - Modular systems reduce overhead and improve game responsiveness
Improved Stability - Fixed memory leaks and platform-specific issues
Enhanced Audio - Better sound processing and resource management
Cross-Platform Support - Improved Linux compatibility and build processes


While these are primarily "under the hood" improvements, they lay the foundation for:

Faster development of new features
More stable gameplay experience
Better mod support in the future
Easier bug fixes and updates

[/expand]

[hr][/hr]

This refactoring effort demonstrates active development focused on code quality, maintainability, and cross-platform compatibility. The modular architecture will enable faster feature development and more stable releases going forward.
